title: Wave B: daemon error handling + workspace registration consolidation
description: Fix error handling in the daemon integration path and consolidate duplicated workspace registration logic. From 2026-05-08 checkpoint review findings F2 and architecture candidate #5.

acceptance_criteria.text: Fix F2: replace `map_err(|_| ())` in try_daemon_register (src/mcp.rs:920) with a richer error enum (ConnectFailed, DaemonError, ParseError). Only fall back to local on ConnectFailed. Surface daemon errors in sutra_status response.
Extract shared `register_workspace` method from sutra_add_root (mcp.rs:786-801) and sutra_status (mcp.rs:876-888). Both become thin wrappers calling the shared method.
Consistent error handling in both code paths after consolidation

edges.note: Wave B after Wave A (fmt + quick fixes first so diffs are clean)
Wave C MCP thinning builds on Wave B workspace consolidation
